name: mz-sql-lsp
description: Registers the mz-deploy language server for .sql files, giving Claude go-to-definition, hover, and symbol navigation across an mz-deploy project.

project_dir.title: mz-deploy project directory
project_dir.description: Path to the directory containing project.toml, relative to your repository root. Enter "." when project.toml sits at the root, or a subdirectory such as "mz" when the project is nested. The language server takes this directory as its project root.
